plan.title: Save your plan
plan.text: Without logging in, your plan is kept for 3 days and then deleted. Continue with Google and we keep it for good — no email or password.

ebag.title: Log in to send the products to eBag
ebag.text: Connecting eBag needs a login. Continue with Google — your plan and list stay.

saved: Done — you’re logged in and your plan is saved.
failed: Logging in didn’t work. Please try again.
